wo-jpfa-JR5793.d:
Job Summary**

PT Agrinusa Jaya Santosa is seeking a dedicated TSR (Technical Sales Representative) Staff for our Animal Health division in Jambi. In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support to poultry farmers and customers, promoting and selling animal health products, and building strong relationships to drive business growth in the Jambi region.

Job Responsibilities**

* Conduct regular visits to farms and distributors in the Jambi area to provide technical consultations and solutions regarding poultry health and management.
* Promote, market, and sell the company's range of animal health products (vaccines, medicines, and feed additives) to meet regional sales targets.
* Monitor disease outbreaks and animal health trends in the field, providing timely feedback and reports to the management team.
* Organize and conduct technical seminars, product presentations, and educational workshops for local farmers and customers.
* Handle customer complaints with professional technical troubleshooting and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with the commercial and marketing teams to develop effective sales strategies tailored to the Jambi market.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Veterinary Medicine (Dokter Hewan) or Animal Husbandry/Animal Science.
* Minimum of 1–2 years of working experience in the animal health, poultry, or feedmill industry (fresh graduates with strong motivation are welcome to apply).
* Deep understanding of poultry disease management, biosecurity protocols, and animal health products.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Possess a valid driver's license (SIM A and/or SIM C) and willingness to travel extensively within the Jambi region.
* Domiciled in Jambi or willing to be relocated to Jambi.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
